settings/devFakeHosts.title: Fake hosts
settings/devFakeHosts.body: Persistently add 20 dummy PS5 cards to the host grid for layout testing. They do not represent real consoles.

settings/devForceWsNode.title: Force PSN push node
settings/devForceWsNode.body: Override the PSN-assigned WebSocket node used for party push updates. Changing it reconnects the push service immediately.

settings/devTakionVersion.title: Takion protocol version
settings/devTakionVersion.body: Override the Remote Play streaming protocol version. Leave this on Auto unless testing protocol compatibility; an incompatible version can prevent streaming.

settings/simulateUpdate.title: Simulate update
settings/simulateUpdate.body: Enter a development update server and open a simulated 9.9.9 update. Choosing Update downloads, verifies, and installs from that server.

settings/tlsVerifyProbe.title: TLS verification probe
settings/tlsVerifyProbe.body: Test whether the HTTP service rejects expired, mismatched, self-signed, and untrusted TLS certificates. Results are written to the log.
